_schema.description: Engines shown on the dashboards: the QVAC engine and the competitors of the campaign in comparisons.json. measured_on is filled by build-dashboard-data.py from the rows; details and source are the campaign's own words.

fields.engine: Engine name exactly as comparisons.json spells it.
fields.role: QVAC engine, prior-report competitor or new competitor, measured.
fields.ggml: ggml-based or not, as a short phrase.
fields.details: Scope and caveats of the engine's rows.

rows.details: Weekly rows from the Sunday run of the engine master and ggml speech heads on every shared machine; campaign rows from the dated comparison at the build the campaign measured.
handy-computer/transcribe.cpp on Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 Q8_0, the same 11.0 s and 98.49 s clips as QVAC.
rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)

rows.details: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 Q8_0 for ASR; Supertonic 3 Q8_0 and the Audio8 TTS Preview LM F16, Q8_0 and Q4_0 cuts for TTS, end-to-end process wall including model load on the same prompts as QVAC.
rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)

rows.details: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 Q8_0 on the same clips as QVAC.
rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)

rows.details: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo with the same four model files as QVAC over ten fixed prompts; one prompt-set RTF and generation-time ratio per device.
